value.title: ROSEN Group in Europe
value.description: Experts from all disciplines work at our locations in Europe, especially in R&D, manufacturing and in supporting the entire group as the 'technology pool'.
value.main_text_excerpt:
ROSEN in Europe and the Commonwealth of Independent States
ROSEN has a long-standing and trusted presence across Europe and the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS). From the North Sea to Central Asia, we support operators in maintaining the safety, reliability, and performance of their critical energy infrastructure.
Our regional operations are coordinated through a network of local offices and strategic hubs, enabling us to deliver tailored solutions that meet the specific needs of each market – whether in highly regulated environments or in emerging energy landscapes.
Our Business: A Trusted Partner in Integrity
ROSEN is a long-standing partner to operators across Europe and the CIS, delivering a wide range of services that ensure the safety, reliability, and performance of critical infrastructure. Our expertise spans in-line inspection and cleaning services for pipelines and facilities, integrity management and engineering consultancy, advanced diagnostics for complex operational challenges and support for hydrogen and CO₂ readiness, decommissioning, and offshore operations. We work across the full asset lifecycle, helping clients meet regulatory requirements, extend asset life, and prepare for the future of energy.
Innovation and Energy Transition: Shaping the Future
Europe is at the forefront of the global energy transition – and so are we. ROSEN is actively supporting the shift to cleaner energy through inspection and integrity solutions for hydrogen and CO₂ pipelines with advanced technologies such as EMAT and digital diagnostics, consulting services for repurposing and decommissioning assets and collaborative innovation with industry leaders and regulators. By combining technical excellence with forward-thinking solutions, we help our clients adapt to change and lead with confidence.
Community
ROSEN Europe is committed to supporting and giving back to the community in which we work and live. To this end, we contribute to a variety of worthy causes that are consistent with our company values. In cooperation with industry partners, we support several local charities.
Local Engagement: Embedded in the Region
Our success is built on strong local relationships. With operational hubs and partnerships in countries such as Germany, the UK, France, Kazakhstan, Ukraine, and beyond, we are embedded in the communities we serve. This local presence enables us to respond quickly and effectively to customer needs, build long-term, trust-based partnerships and support local employment and knowledge transfer. We believe in acting locally while leveraging the strength of our global network.

pages.title: We are empowered by technology
pages.main_text_excerpt:
We are empowered by technology
For us, technology is the driving force of progress to ensure a more sustainable future for our customers, their assets and society.
As a global technology company, we deliver comprehensive asset integrity management solutions for all areas of the integrity process chain of industrial assets. Our team of more than 4,000 employees operates in more than 110 countries world-wide – empowering our customers to make the best decisions for the safety, lifetime and performance of their critical industrial assets.
Data-driven technologies for comprehensive asset integrity management
With a portfolio of highly advanced proprietary diagnostic technologies, a vast and unique data set, and industry-leading software solutions combined with integrity engineering consulting services, we provide distinctive capabilities to deliver a comprehensive understanding of asset safety, lifetime, and performance.
Our product and service portfolio offers inspection and non-destructive testing solutions, integrity assessments, engineering consultancy services, software solutions as well as cleaning services and products for various assets including pipelines, storage tanks and processing facilities:

pages.title: Get in Touch with Us Now!
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Get in Touch with Us!
Do you have questions or remarks or would like to speak to us directly? Let us know how we can help you. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

pages.title: Explore Our Latest News and Press Releases
pages.main_text_excerpt: Welcome to our news corner! Dive into the latest updates on our initiatives and the solutions we've provided to various industries and explore our news and press releases.

pages.title: Your Career at ROSEN
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Careers with ROSEN
For over 40 years, our global growth has proven our ability to attract, retain and develop innovative and motivated colleagues who continue to drive our business forward. Every day, each of them contributes to ensuring the safety and sustainability of the energy industry and supporting the global transition to greener energy sources. With a range of flexible and challenging roles in over 40 global locations, you can take the next step in your career with us.
Our people use their expertise to leverage the technologies we use and provide solutions to our customer’s complex challenges across a range of terrains. Their interdisciplinary and international cooperation across all locations and national borders and the commitment they show every day make a real difference.

pages.title: Discover Jobs at ROSEN
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Jobs at ROSEN
Whether you are looking for a new challenge, your next career move, or your first job ever, we are able to offer a variety of roles, entry levels and career opportunities across all of our global locations. As part of the diverse ROSEN family, you will have the opportunity each day to grow with us and help us do great things, together. Browse the wide variety of jobs we offer below.

pages.title: Great Things Are Done Together
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Great Things Are Done Together
A career at ROSEN can provide all our colleagues, at all levels of the company, the opportunity to make a real contribution at a personal level towards meeting the energy challenges faced today. Protecting our environment and our communities is at the heart of everything we do, and our culture and work environment ensure that we provide the perfect framework to achieve our business and personal goals.
